mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis suppression effects of budesonide and increases risk of hypertensive crisis if combined with sympathomimetic amines that may be used concomitantly.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and watch for signs of HPA axis suppression; ensure no sympathomimetic agents are used concurrently; consider alternative antidepressant if clinically appropriate.
